reviews.title: Failed In Every Way!
reviews.text:
This app was demoed with the iPhone 11 Pro launch and I paid $15 for it based on a promise to add the features shown in that video (recording all camera in raw formats simultaneously). 

Those features were never added and now they want me to pay for a subscription to get the limited features they do have. 

Scam artists at best!

reviews.title: Filmic Pro isn’t what it used to be
reviews.text: Their tech support is non-existent.  I put in a support ticket because their delog LUTs on their website leads to a broken link so you can’t even access them and those are needed to delog the files I captured.  I tried on multiple browsers.  48 hours later and not a peep from their support team other than an AI bot that was useless.  Do not buy this app.  There are better options out there now like the BlackMagic Camera app.

reviews.title: Crashes all the time, invasive “review app” pop ups
reviews.text:
Constantly crashing and I lose the whole video.  iPhone 14 Pro, latest iOS, latest Filmic Pro.  I can’t use it anymore because I can’t trust it not to crash half way through a great (or irreplaceable) take and lose it.   Unfortunate because otherwise the app and remote functionality are great.

Plus every single time you use this app it asks you to rate it here.  Every time!  I’m in the middle of filming and have to dismiss a “rate our app!” Popup every time I use the app and I’ve already left a review.  This part is just unbelievable and completely inexcusable, obnoxious and tone deaf.

reviews.title: Subscription Based Now :/ it used to be $10 lifetime.
reviews.text:
I used to have the original which was a one time flat rate for $10 life time. I’m not paying $10 per month. I’m not paying $100 per year. Just to have a little more flexibility with my filming on a phone I already own. 

These prices are for people who want to blow money away.

Filmic the math doesn’t add up. All those hundreds makes more sense to go towards actual camera gear that will not charge an arm and a leg each time I use it.

Maybe $5 per year…. But nothing more. You used to do $10 life time. Don’t pretend you didn’t.

Expensive subscriptions will kill this company eventually.

reviews.title: Sound and audio mismatching
reviews.text:
I shot 7 videos today, each 8 minutes and longer on Filmic pro. Half of them the audio and video are totally mismatched. 
No we have to reshoot these scenes and it’s caused major disruptions in production.

reviews.title: Shame to see a app fall due to subscription modeling.
reviews.text:
Really loved the app, despite all the bugs, I still held it dear to my work. Now I’m order for me to get the latest update, I will now have to subscribe to a pricing model I refuse to pay. Beast cam is now my to go to after this update. It’s a shame that you won’t honor those who have been with you since the development of the app. What’s worst is that the app will soon force you to update once newer IOS versions come out, forcing grandfathered users into a subscription base terms. Very disheartening and hope the team can sort this out.

I remembered I had this cool app I bought for filming with iPhone.  Open the app and lo and behold it now wants me to join a subscription to make any camera changes like I’ve been able to do for years.  Thumbs down to this kind of BS.

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: I made the lifetime purchase, which was not cheap, then this scammer of a company just made an entirely new app to force the subscription model for any further updates while sunsetting the previous ’version’. This is a bait and switch tactic that Apple needs to do something about. Total scammers and utterly disloyal to all the people who bought into their ‘lifetime’ lie. There are great alternatives out there so I strongly suggest avoiding this company.

Not worth the trouble at all if they can’t have standard refund policies or customer support channels.

reviews.title: Stay far away
reviews.text: I paid the fee to have full access to the pro features a couple years ago, and now they have removed my access in favor of a subscription service. Here is the thing, I already paid for the full access, I shouldn’t have to then paid all over again because YOU the developer decided to be greedy. Many users have reported their loss of access and so I have decided to never use this app again. It was nice, but their choices have made it very clear it’s not about filmmaking, it’s about money.
